sheets.prompt: Character design sheet for a science fiction exploration game: the headwear of a silent order of riders of great birds, in white and ivory robes among red rock needles. Two pieces, each worn by a head-and-shoulders figure, front, three-quarter and back view: the order's cowl of heavy ivory cloth, rising to a low soft point behind the head and falling over the shoulders; a lighter travelling hood thrown forward against the wind. Both close round the face, no taller than a hand above the head, one clear silhouette each, readable from far away. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, ivory, bone white and a single red cord, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels, costume party.
